fusions.name: Thrown to the Door
fusions.desc: Hurls a spear a long way, dealing 36 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Skewer
fusions.desc: Thrusts through the target, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Braced Haft
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Point of Order
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, a spear flies at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
